linh.name: Linh
linh.delivery: Warm Southern Vietnamese woman, 26. Tired but observant; a soft, personal tone. Do not dramatise fear. Leave room around money and references to her mother.

bao.name: Bảo
bao.delivery: Young adult man, 23. Relaxed, lightly humorous, then thoughtful around the tax letters. Clear and conversational, never an advertisement.
bao.design: A 23-year-old man speaking English with a clearly Australian accent from Sydney. Natural Australian vowel sounds and non-rhotic pronunciation, not American or British. Youthful mid-low register, a light smile and gentle dry humour. An ordinary close conversation after a long delivery shift, with relaxed rhythm and small breaths. Warm, clear, unforced, not a radio announcer, not an exaggerated broad accent. Clean dry studio audio with no background sound.
bao.referenceText: Stay under the awning; it drips right where you are standing. I have just got home from the last delivery. The food stayed dry, but I did not. At least there is time for a cup of tea now.

hanh.name: Cô Hạnh
hanh.delivery: Central Vietnamese woman, 54. Welcoming, measured and practically minded. Gentle mature warmth, never frail or helpless; concern for her daughter is contained.

tram.name: Trâm
tram.delivery: Young adult woman, 20. Quiet and attentive, clear when setting boundaries. A little brightness around photography. No threatening impressions or distressed performance.
tram.design: A 20-year-old adult woman speaking English with a natural General American accent. Soft clear mid-to-high voice, youthful but not childlike. Quiet, observant, slightly reserved, with a gentle thoughtful warmth and small natural breaths. Rhotic American pronunciation, conversational cadence, not a presenter or a dramatic actress. She is calmly telling one nearby listener a personal story. Clean dry studio audio, no music or background noise.
tram.referenceText: I used to take photographs on the way home. Nothing special, just the light in the windows and people waiting for a bus. I would like to start doing that again. We can talk here for a little while.

duc.name: Đức
duc.delivery: Northern Vietnamese man, 41. Measured mid-low voice, thoughtful and slightly distracted by the bicycle. Unease is in the pauses, not forced sadness; the bell returns some warmth.

khoa.name: Khoa
khoa.delivery: Adult man, 33. Grounded, thoughtful, with a dry smile about the lemon tree. A lower and more measured register than Bảo; maintain dignity when describing unfair treatment.
khoa.design: A 33-year-old man speaking English with a natural Australian accent from New South Wales. Distinctly Australian vowels and non-rhotic pronunciation. A mellow lower baritone, slightly textured, steady and thoughtful. More mature and unhurried than a young delivery rider. Quiet dry humour, modest warmth, natural breaths. An intimate ordinary conversation, not a newsreader, not theatrical or exaggerated. Clean dry studio recording with no background noise.
khoa.referenceText: The lemon tree has finally started growing again. I thought I had lost it over the winter, but there are new leaves now. Come in out of the rain. There is no hurry; I can tell you what happened.

mai.name: Mai
mai.delivery: Adult woman, 29. Private and focused, a lower and more settled voice than Trâm. Small hesitations near the phone; firmer when setting her own limits. No sobbing or horror tone.
mai.design: A 29-year-old woman speaking English with a natural General American accent. A warm low-mid female register, a little husky, intimate and composed. Clearly an adult, more settled and lower voiced than a twenty-year-old. Rhotic American pronunciation. Private, reflective and gently cautious, with occasional small breaths and pauses. She speaks naturally to one trusted listener, never a broadcast announcer or dramatic performance. Clean dry studio audio without background noise.
mai.referenceText: I am fixing this dress for my niece. The stitching keeps wandering because the machine is so old. Her birthday is next month, and I promised her a real pocket. She likes collecting little stones.
